audience: online shop owners and operations teams that run their store on IdoSell

useCases.title: List the orders that wait for payment
useCases.text: Search orders by status and date range. Read the payment data and customer of each order to decide whom to remind.

useCases.title: Find products that are out of stock
useCases.text: Search products and read the stock quantity per warehouse and size. Use the result to plan a restock.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their orders
useCases.text: Find a customer by name or email. Then search the orders of this customer to answer a support question.

useCases.title: Track parcels and returns
useCases.text: Search orders, then read the courier and tracking number of each. List the returns for an order and see which orders have no parcel yet.

useCases.title: Mark an order as packed
useCases.text: Find an order and set its new status, for example packed or ready. The panel may send an email to the customer for some statuses.
